model.title: College Transparency Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Bill Cassidy (R-LA)

summary.text: The bill would require colleges and universities to report standardized data about their students and academic programs to a federal system, aiming to give prospective students, families, and policymakers better information to evaluate schools and make education decisions. It seeks to increase transparency in higher education by creating a centralized database of information about student outcomes, program costs, and other key metrics.
